// GenClass regression test for finding f1 (race), generated from run r6.
// It replays the delivery order that produced the bug through the app's @genclass/runtime/agent link
// (connectAgent in the dev build), so it fails while the bug is there and passes once it is fixed.
// The recorded strings below came from the page; they are test data.
import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";

const APP = process.env.GENCLASS_APP_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";
const SCHEDULE = {"order":"seeded","seed":4,"delay":{"minMs":0,"maxMs":600},"maxHoldMs":2100};

test("/websites: the final state does not depend on response order (GenClass f1)", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.addInitScript((s) => { (window as any).__GENCLASS_SCHEDULE__ = s; }, SCHEDULE);
  await page.goto(APP + "/websites");
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => !!(window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__), "the dev build calls connectAgent(rt) from @genclass/runtime/agent").toBe(true);
  await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.whenSettled(15000));
  await page.getByLabel("Search", { exact: true }).or(page.getByPlaceholder("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.getByTitle("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.locator("[name=\"Search\"], [id=\"Search\"]")).first().click();
  await page.getByLabel("Search", { exact: true }).or(page.getByPlaceholder("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.getByTitle("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.locator("[name=\"Search\"], [id=\"Search\"]")).first().fill("");
  await page.getByLabel("Search", { exact: true }).or(page.getByPlaceholder("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.getByTitle("Search", { exact: true })).or(page.locator("[name=\"Search\"], [id=\"Search\"]")).first().pressSequentially("shop st", { delay: 224 });
  await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.whenSettled(15000));
  const witnesses = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.witnesses());
  const errors = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.errors());
  const snap = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__GENCLASS_AGENT__.snapshot());
  void witnesses; void errors; void snap;
  expect(snap.state["search.external9.data.data"], "as with responses in request order").toBe("10 items [{id: \"104f54a2-58c3-4b79-89a3…\", +13}, …]");
  expect(snap.state["search.external9.data.count"], "as with responses in request order").toBe("10");
  expect(snap.state["search.external9.data.search"], "as with responses in request order").toBe("\"sho\"");
  expect(snap.state["eiY.state1"], "as with responses in request order").toBe("Set(10)");
  expect(snap.state["A_3.state0.renderTree.varyPath.parent"], "as with responses in request order").toBe("{id: 0, value: \"?search=sho&page=1\", isRootParam: false, parent: null}");
  expect(snap.text, "the page shows what it shows with responses in request order").toContain("shop site 1");
  expect(snap.text, "the page shows what it shows with responses in request order").toContain("shop-site-1.example.com");
  expect(snap.text, "the page shows what it shows with responses in request order").toContain("8 minutes ago");
  expect(snap.text, "the page does not show what only the failing order showed").not.toContain("9 minutes ago");
  expect(snap.text, "the page does not show what only the failing order showed").not.toContain("9 minutes ago");
  expect(snap.text, "the page does not show what only the failing order showed").not.toContain("9 minutes ago");
